title: Loudest banjo player in the city
summary: Julius says he is called the loudest banjo player and his father taught him his way; tone is about strokes, not strength.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: So. Different strokes for different folks. That's right.
Well, I am, they all tell me everywhere that I'm the loudest fan here player in the city. Which I go along with them. Because, my daddy taught me a certain way.
Does that have anything to do with strength? No, it doesn't.
